name.text: Graphing a linear inequality in two unknowns

questiontext.text:
Solve and graph the following linear inequality in two unknowns:

\( \displaystyle y > {@m@}x + {@c@} \)

a) < Find the axes intercepts for the boundary equation \( y = {@m@}x + {@c@} \).

(Enter the numerical values for the intercepts below.)

\(y\)-intercept (when \(x = 0\)): \( y = \) [[input:ans1]]

\(x\)-intercept (when \(y = 0\)): \( x = \) [[input:ans2]]

\(y\)-intercept check: [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]
\(x\)-intercept check: [[validation:ans2]] [[feedback:prt2]]

b) Graph the inequality on the Cartesian plane below:

  1. Drag the two blue points to set the boundary line. (Notice the line is dashed because the inequality is strict: \(>\)).
  2. Drag the green Region Marker into the area that satisfies the inequality \( y > {@m@}x + {@c@} \).

generalfeedback.text:
Worked Solution:

Part a: The Algebraic Boundary

To plot the boundary line \( y = {@m@}x + {@c@} \), we find the axes intercepts.

For the \(y\)-intercept, we set \( x = 0 \):

\( \displaystyle \begin{aligned} y &= {@m@}(0) + {@c@} \\ y &= {@ta1@} \end{aligned} \)

For the \(x\)-intercept, we set \( y = 0 \) and solve for \( x \):

\( \displaystyle \begin{aligned} 0 &= {@m@}x + {@c@} \\ -{@c@} &= {@m@}x \\ x &= {@ta2@} \end{aligned} \)

The boundary line passes through \((0, {@ta1@})\) and \(({@ta2@}, 0)\).

Part b: Graphical Representation

We plot the two intercepts on the Cartesian plane and draw a dashed line through them because the inequality is strictly greater than (\(>\)).

Next, we determine which region to shade using a test point. The easiest test point is the origin \((0,0)\). We substitute \(x = 0\) and \(y = 0\) into our inequality:

\( \displaystyle \begin{aligned} y &> {@m@}x + {@c@} \\ 0 &> {@m@}(0) + {@c@} \\ 0 &> {@c@} \end{aligned} \)

This statement {@origin_statement@}. Therefore, we place our region marker on the corresponding side of the dashed line to indicate the entire shaded area.

[[jsxgraph width="400px" height="400px"]] var m = {#m#}; var c = {#c#}; var brd = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [-10.5, 10.5, 10.5, -10.5], axis: false, grid: false, showNavigation: false, showCopyright: false, pan: {enabled: false}, zoom: {enabled: false} }); var xaxis = brd.create('axis', [[0, 0], [1, 0]], { name: 'x', withLabel: true, label: {position: 'rt', offset: [-15, 20]}, firstArrow: true, lastArrow: true, strokeWidth: 1.5, ticks: { drawLabels: true, label: {offset: [-8, -15]}, drawZero: true, insertTicks: false, ticksDistance: 2, minorTicks: 1, majorHeight: -1, minorHeight: -1, strokeColor: '#a0a0a0', strokeOpacity: 0.5, strokeWidth: 1, minorStrokeColor: '#e0e0e0', minorStrokeOpacity: 0.5, minorStrokeWidth: 1 } }); var yaxis = brd.create('axis', [[0, 0], [0, 1]], { name: 'y', withLabel: true, label: {position: 'rt', offset: [15, -15]}, firstArrow: true, lastArrow: true, strokeWidth: 1.5, ticks: { drawLabels: true, label: {offset: [-25, -5]}, drawZero: false, insertTicks: false, ticksDistance: 2, minorTicks: 1, majorHeight: -1, minorHeight: -1, strokeColor: '#a0a0a0', strokeOpacity: 0.5, strokeWidth: 1, minorStrokeColor: '#e0e0e0', minorStrokeOpacity: 0.5, minorStrokeWidth: 1 } }); /* Draw correct boundary line */ var p1 = brd.create('point', [0, c], {visible: false}); var p2 = brd.create('point', [1, m + c], {visible: false}); var line = brd.create('line', [p1, p2], {strokeWidth: 3, strokeColor: '#1565c0', dash: 2}); /* Shade the correct region (inverse: true means we shade y > mx + c) */ var ineq = brd.create('inequality', [line], {fillColor: '#4caf50', fillOpacity: 0.2, inverse: true}); /* Show the marker in a generic correct spot */ var mx = 0; var my = c + 4; brd.create('point', [mx, my], {name: 'Solution Region', size: 6, strokeColor: '#2e7d32', fillColor: '#4caf50', fixed: true}); [[/jsxgraph]]
